home.1: SPICES WITH AUTHENTIC FLAVORS, HARVESTED DIRECTLY FROM THE FARMERS
home.2: Discover authentic aromatic treasures, directly harvested from the farmers. Each flavor embodies a relationship of trust between the land, skilled hands, and your palate. Explore a world of delights transcending borders.
home.5: At Madepices, our commitment lies in the meticulous creation of quality work focused on exceptional products. Our approach extends from the initial collection to the final packaging, ensuring consistent excellence at every stage of the process. We take great care in selecting the finest raw materials, venturing to the most remote corners to find unique aromatic treasures. Guided by our passion, we preserve the purity and authenticity of each product while paying meticulous attention to packaging to maintain their freshness and unique character. Our dedication to excellence drives us to offer exceptional parfum experiences enriched with deep flavors and captivating aromas that reflect the very essence of Madagascar.
home.7: Immersed in the heart of Madagascar, we passionately commit ourselves to select and craft the finest spices. Excellence is our compass, leading us to explore every corner of this island with its priceless treasures, in search of unique flavors. Each spice, born from meticulous cultivation, blends the essence of the land with ancient craftsmanship. Our process, from harvest to preparation, aims to capture the very essence of Madagascar. These deep aromas and authentic flavors, the result of meticulous work, will awaken your senses and elevate your culinary creations. Join us on this gastronomic adventure where each spice tells a story of passion, quality, and tradition, bridging the past and the present.

caroussel.2: Integrated into our daily lives, spices are cherished for their flavors, aromas, and health benefits. Their presence enriches our meals and our lives, adding a sensory touch while contributing to our well-being. Spices transcend mere parfum to become a holistic experience.
caroussel.3: FLAVOR EXPLOSION WITH OUR UNIQUE SPICES
caroussel.4: Elevate your dishes by exploring spices, awakening your senses, and delighting your parfum buds. Dive into a culinary adventure where each flavor transports, and each aroma enchants. Spices transform cooking into a sensory experience, adding depth and vibrancy to every bite. Discover the world of flavors with us.
caroussel.7: Embark on a sensory journey with Madepices, exploring authentic spices that blend traditions and innovations. Surrender to enchanting aromas and exotic flavors, a unique experience guided by our passion.

about.2: MADEPICES, a company established in 2011, specializes in the preparation of spices and the marketing of agri-food and cosmetic products based on spices. We focus primarily on the artisanal aspect. We offer high-quality products: hand-sorted, prepared, and calibrated by a team with 20 years of experience in the field. We guarantee a variety of premium spices, carefully selected, natural, and seasonal to meet your expectations.
about.3: Eco-responsible, we select around 20 seasonal raw materials from the most beautiful plantations in Madagascar, coming from different regions of Madagascar. The materials are processed in our factory in Antananarivo and marketed to gourmets and gastronomes around the world. MADEPICES pushes its creativity to personalized and unique packaging by adding caps or rosewood boxes crafted in our woodworking workshop.
about.4: Dive into our vast selection of local products, recognized as 'the Best Spices of Madagascar.' A sensory experience awaits you, filling your parfum buds with refined flavors. MADEPICES, bearer of a passion for exquisite parfums, invites you to explore this aromatic heritage. Let yourself be seduced by authentic aromas and unforgettable sensations, and discover a new dimension of passion for flavors.

product-6.description: Cacao bean is the seed of the cacao fruit. It is often used in chocolate production and also in the preparation of hot chocolate drinks, desserts, pastries, etc.

product-7.name: CINNAMON
product-7.description: Cinnamon is often used in a variety of sweet and savory dishes, such as desserts, pastries, hot beverages. It can be sprinkled on fruits, added to marinades, incorporated into spice blends, and more.

product-8.name: LEMONGRASS
product-8.description: Lemongrass is frequently used in Asian cuisine, especially in Thai and Vietnamese dishes. It adds a lemony flavor and herbal note to soups, curries, marinades, sauces, and beverages.

product-9.name: KAFFIR LIME LEAF
product-9.description: Kaffir lime leaves are used in many Asian dishes, such as curries, soups, marinades, and sauces. They can be used fresh or dried and are often removed before serving the dish.

product-10.name: KAFFIR LIME ZEST
product-10.description: Kaffir lime zest is used to flavor both sweet and savory dishes, such as pastries, desserts, marinades, cocktails, and sauces. It is also used in the preparation of teas and infusions.

product-11.name: CORIANDER
product-11.description: Coriander seeds are used in many cuisines worldwide to flavor dishes, while ground seeds are commonly used in spice blends, sauces, soups, and sausages.

product-12.name: SOURSOP LEAF
product-12.description: Soursop leaves are used in the preparation of various dishes and beverages, including teas, infusions, and juices.

product-13.name: CUMIN
product-13.description: Cumin is widely used, especially in Indian, Mexican, and Middle Eastern cuisine, to flavor dishes, soups, sauces, and marinades. Ground cumin is commonly used in curries, tacos, and couscous.

product-14.name: TURMERIC
product-14.description: Turmeric is widely used in Asian cuisine, especially in curries, sauces, marinades, and spice blends. It is also used as a natural food coloring.

product-16.name: SPECIAL MEAT CURRY
product-16.description: Special meat curry is a spice blend used to prepare flavorful and spicy meat dishes. It typically consists of a mix of spices such as turmeric, cumin, coriander, ginger, pepper, cinnamon, cardamom, and cloves.

product-17.name: GUACAMOLE SPICE
product-17.description: Common spices used in guacamole include ground cumin, ground red pepper, garlic powder, ground coriander, ground nutmeg, fine white salt, and parsley powder.

product-18.name: FENUGREEK
product-18.description: Fenugreek is commonly used in Indian, Mediterranean, and Asian cuisines. It is used to flavor meat dishes, broths, and marinades. It is also used in the production of cheeses and breads.

product-19.name: NATURAL FLEUR DE SEL
product-19.description: Fleur de sel is a delicate and crunchy sea salt used as a final seasoning to enhance the flavors of dishes. This makes it a premium product appreciated by chefs and cooking enthusiasts.

product-20.name: GINGER
product-20.description: Ginger is widely used in Asian cuisines, especially in Indian, Chinese, and Thai dishes. It is used to flavor meat dishes, stir-fries, curries, marinades, soups, sauces, and beverages like ginger tea.

product-21.name: CLOVES
product-21.description: Cloves are a versatile spice appreciated for their spicy parfum, intense aroma, and medicinal properties. They are widely used in cooking, natural medicine, and for their repellent and aromatic effects.

product-22.name: GARAM MASALA
product-22.description: Garam masala is used as a seasoning in many Indian dishes, such as curries, stews, sauces, marinades, and meat dishes. It can also be added to vegetable dishes, rice, soups, and lentils to give them a more complex flavor.

product-23.name: 3-BERRY BLEND
product-23.description: 3-berry blend is a spice mixture typically composed of black peppercorns, white peppercorns, and pink peppercorns. Together, they offer a balanced and complex blend of flavors.

product-24.name: 4-SPICE BLEND
product-24.description: 4-spice blend is a traditional spice mixture typically made up of black pepper, nutmeg, cloves, and cinnamon. Black pepper adds a spicy flavor, nutmeg brings a warm and woody note, cloves add an intense and spicy flavor, while cinnamon contributes a sweet and aromatic flavor.

product-25.name: NUTMEG
product-25.description: Nutmeg is used in many dishes and beverages, including sauces, soups, stews, desserts, hot drinks, and cheese-based dishes. It can be used in powder form or according to preferences and the recipe.

product-26.name: RED CHILI PILI PILI
product-26.description: Red chili is used in many cuisines worldwide to add heat and spiciness to dishes. It is often found in sauces, marinades, spicy dishes, soups, meats, and vegetable-based dishes.

product-27.name: GREEN CHILI PILI PILI
product-27.description: Green chili is a variety of chili that is less spicy and has a milder flavor. It offers a slight touch of heat with a crunchy texture. It is used in many culinary preparations to add flavor and color.

product-28.name: TSILANINDIMILAHY CHILI
product-28.description: Tsilanindimilahy chili is a variety of chili native to Madagascar. It is widely used in Malagasy cuisine to add heat and flavor to dishes, including curries, meat dishes, and more.

product-29.name: WHITE PEPPER
product-29.description: White pepper is often used in dishes where one wants to avoid black specks, such as white sauces, soups, fish or poultry dishes, as well as vegetable-based dishes.

product-30.name: BLACK PEPPER
product-30.description: Black pepper is used in many dishes and recipes worldwide. It adds flavor and heat to sauces, meats, vegetables, soups, and marinades.

product-31.name: BLACK VOATSIPERIFERY PEPPER
product-31.description: Black Voatsiperifery pepper from Madagascar is a specific variety of black pepper that comes from the forested region of Madagascar. Black Voatsiperifery pepper is grown exclusively in Madagascar, in the island's tropical forests. It is hand-harvested and is considered one of the rarest and most precious peppers in the world.

product-32.name: VANILLA BEAN
product-32.description: Vanilla is widely used as a flavoring in food products. It is commonly used in desserts such as ice creams, pastries, hot drinks, and sweet sauces. It can also be used in some savory dishes to add a subtle aroma.

product-33.name: MORINGA
product-33.description: Moringa leaves, flowers, and seeds are edible. The leaves can be consumed raw, cooked, or in powdered form. The seeds can be used to extract nutrient-rich oil. Moringa is also used in the preparation of tea, soups, salads, and smoothies.

product-39.name: PINEAPPLE
product-39.description: Dried pineapple is a fruit with multiple virtues. It is very rich in fiber and contains vitamin C. It has dietary virtues and can serve as an appetite suppressant. It can be enjoyed as a confectionery or used in dessert recipes. Dried pineapple is perfect for preparing flavored rums.

product-40.name: MANGO
product-40.description: Sliced dried mangoes have a bright yellow color, indicating the presence of carotenoids (provitamin A). Like all dried fruits, they contain 5 times more minerals than fresh fruits. They are mainly rich in potassium and magnesium.

product-41.name: LYCHEE
product-41.description: Madagascar lychee is among the most sought after in the world. Refreshing and exotic...consumed in fruit salads or cooked in pastries, it's a delight. You can also incorporate it into preparations such as jam or sorbet.

product-42.name: JACKFRUIT
product-42.description: When jackfruit is ripe, the smell of its skin can be off-putting, but once removed, the aroma and parfum are similar to mango, banana, and pineapple. You can consume the dried fruits directly or add them to your fruit salads or alcohol infusions.

product-43.name: POK POK
product-43.description: This small berry, protected by its elegant ribbed calyx when the fruit is ripe, offers a tangy and delicately sweet parfum. They can be nibbled on as they are or incorporated into culinary preparations or fruit salads. They are also perfect for preparing flavored rums and pair particularly well with vanilla and cocoa.

contact-faq.2: MADÉPICES distributes locally sourced spices that are well-treated, with no preservatives or additives. We know where our products come from, and we are acquainted with the farmers who supply us. Everything is involved in the final quality. It's up to you to judge. Taste them, and you'll see!
contact-faq.3: 2. What is the best way to store spices?
contact-faq.4: For optimal shelf life, it's best to keep them in a cool, dry place, away from direct sunlight and air to prevent alterations in their quality. We recommend protecting them in secure packaging such as airtight containers, tinted glass jars, etc., to preserve freshness and flavor.
contact-faq.5: 3. Which spices are most commonly used?
contact-faq.6: Frequently used spices vary depending on global cuisine. Among the most common are peppers, berries, voatsiperifery unique to Madagascar, cinnamon, cumin, and turmeric, which are in high demand. They are specific and add a burst of flavor to dishes.
contact-faq.7: 4. What is the difference between a spice and a leaf?
contact-faq.8: The main difference between these two products lies in the part of the plant used. Spices are generally derived from parts other than leaves, such as bark, roots, or seeds. Leaves, on the other hand, come from the leaves of plants.
